primary_sources.venue: Bulletin of the Australian Mathematical Society 113 (2026), 390-403
primary_sources.exact_source_locator: Printed p. 391 / PDF p. 2 / extracted.md lines 68--79: Theorem 1.1 gives limsup P(n!+f(n))/n >= 1+9 log 2 and positive lower asymptotic density above (1+9 log 2-epsilon)n; the following paragraph identifies Lemma 2.7 as the new ingredient.

proof_anatomy.cofinal_supply: Choose q at least B!+5. Wilson gives q dividing (q-2)!-1. At the least hit m, the alternative m<=B would force q<=m!-1<=B!, contradiction.
proof_anatomy.finite_product: If a product of selected primes exceeds the product of all earlier factorial gaps, at least one selected prime avoids every earlier gap; Wilson bounds its first possible hit.
proof_anatomy.reflection: For an odd hit q dividing n!-1, Wilson rearrangement gives q dividing (q-n-1)!-1; the source's block hypotheses place the reflected index in the collision core.
proof_anatomy.genuinely_hard_step: Prove cofinally that a supplied moving factor meets both quantitative closing estimates despite reflected collisions. This is absent.
